description: V4-exact relational transformer over geometry tokens: 1 global token embedded from (h, p) and 4 resonator tokens embedded by ONE shared GELU MLP from (rx_i, ry_i, theta_i, sin/cos 2theta_i, (rx_i-ry_i)cos/sin 2theta_i, rx_i+ry_i, h, p); n_layers pre-LN transformer blocks (d_model, 8 heads, GELU FFN 4x, dropout) whose attention logits get a learned per-head bias indexed by the token-pair relation (resonators i,j: i XOR j = the supercell translation (12)(34)/(13)(24)/(14)(23) mapping i to j; 3 global<->resonator types), no absolute resonator positions, so the output is exactly invariant to sub-c
model_repr:
V4RelTransformer(
  (res_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=10, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (glob_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=2, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-2): 3 x Block(
      (n1): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (att): RelAttention(
        (qkv): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=768, bias=True)
        (proj): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (n2): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=1024, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    (3): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=1024, bias=True)
    (4): GELU(approximate='none')
    (5): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    (6): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=2001, bias=True)
  )
)
